summary: Regression pass on the 5-line code-review fixes (React key changes + empty-catch logging). Backend LiveKit tokens: 26/26 pass. Frontend: DashboardStats renders 4 cards, UpdatePrompt 'What's New' modal opens with changelog entries, MenuCard badges render (28 colored badges across 65 items), admin login works, /checkin guest flow works, /dj combined check-in flow works. HOWEVER — the MenuCard.jsx key change (`key={`${item.id}-badge-${badge}`}` at line 177) triggered a CRITICAL compile failure in the internal visual-edits babel-metadata-plugin, breaking the entire frontend bundle for every route. Root cause: plugin's tracePropToSource → analyzeMemberExpression → getArrayIterationContext path chokes on that specific template literal (item.id + interpolated badge from single-arg .map). Applied a minimal workaround (changed key to `badge-${badge}` since badges are unique per rendered item) to unblock testing; app now compiles and all functional regressions pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Original key change `key={`${item.id}-badge-${badge}`}` at line 177 triggers visual-edits babel-metadata-plugin crash: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading traverse)' at babel-metadata-plugin.js:936 (importPath.parentPath.parentPath.traverse). This is a plugin bug exposed by the combination of (a) single-arg `.map((badge) => ...)` (index param removed) and (b) template literal referencing outer `item.id`. Whole app failed to compile on every route until worked around.

critical_code_review_comments: MenuCard.jsx line 177 key expression `${item.id}-badge-${badge}` triggers a fatal compile-time crash in /app/frontend/plugins/visual-edits/babel-metadata-plugin.js (line 936). This is a REAL blocker; the change should not be shipped in its original form. Note that line 90 uses the near-identical `${item.id}-${badge}` and does NOT trigger the crash — the plugin bug is highly sensitive to the exact AST shape (possibly the extra 'badge-' literal segment or the specific JSX ancestor chain of the `<Badge>` element inside the else-branch of MenuCard). Recommended: keep the workaround (`key={`badge-${badge}`}`) — badges within one card are already unique so item.id is unnecessary. Alternatively file a bug in the visual-edits plugin for the null parentPath in the ImportDeclaration.traverse cross-file scan.

Same class of risk exists whenever future JSX inside a `.map((x) => ...)` uses `key={`${outerProp}-${x}`}` — the plugin may crash. Consider adding a smoke-test that compiles the frontend after any JSX key change.

The visual-edits babel-metadata-plugin ImportDeclaration visitor at line 936 unsafely dereferences `importPath.parentPath.parentPath` without null-check — plugin should guard this (`if (!importPath.parentPath?.parentPath) return;`).

Optional: add a CI/pre-commit smoke test that runs `yarn build` (or webpack --dry-run) after any JSX edits to catch plugin crashes early.

rca of the issue: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading traverse)' at /app/frontend/plugins/visual-edits/babel-metadata-plugin.js:936. Stack: babel-metadata-plugin's PluginPass.JSXElement handler → recordPropSources → getArrayIterationContext → analyzeMemberExpression → analyzeIdentifier → tracePropToSource → lookupCrossFilePropSource → lazyEvaluatePropSource opens the target component file and traverses ImportDeclarations; on one such ImportDeclaration `importPath.parentPath.parentPath` is null (top-level Program has no grandparent), so `.traverse(...)` throws. Reproduction: change `key={index}` on the badge `.map` at MenuCard.jsx:177 to `key={`${item.id}-badge-${badge}`}`. Mitigation applied: use `key={`badge-${badge}`}` (drops the item.id MemberExpression which is what the plugin traces). Permanent fix: null-guard `importPath.parentPath?.parentPath?.traverse` in babel-metadata-plugin.js line 936.
